components.name: introText
components.content:
Use this service to order a radon risk report for a property in the UK.

The report shows the likelihood, as a percentage (such as 3-5%), of a property having radon levels above the Action Level advised by the UK Health Security Agency.

components.name: actionLevelInset
components.content: The Action Level for radon in homes is 200 becquerels per cubic metre (Bq m<sup>-3</sup>). A becquerel is a measure of radioactivity. If the radon level in your property is higher than this, you should take steps to reduce it.

components.name: reportDetailsText
components.content:
The report does not tell you the radon level inside the property. To find this out, you need to do a 3‑month test using a radon gas test kit.

Basements and cellar rooms are at a higher risk of radon. If a room you use frequently is below ground level, such as a kitchen or office, you should do a radon test, even if the property is not in a radon Affected Area.

Each report costs £3.90 and will be sent to an email address you provide. Alternatively, you can request a physical report to be sent by Royal Mail 1st Class for £5.51.

Read a sample report

Before you start

This service is for buildings up to 25 metres in any direction (this does not refer to the height of the building or basement depth).

This report is not suitable for larger buildings. In this case, contact the British Geological Survey (BGS).

You'll need:

  • a valid UK address for the risk report
  • a valid email address or a UK postal delivery address
  • your payment details
